name: grok-build-desktop-tauri
description: Tauri 2 desktop client for Grok Build (ACP over agent serve) — port of grok-build-desktop

scripts.dev:wayland: unset GDK_BACKEND; WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE=1 WAYLAND_DISPLAY=${WAYLAND_DISPLAY:-wayland-0} tauri dev
scripts.dev:x11: unset GDK_BACKEND; GDK_BACKEND=x11 DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:0} WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE=1 tauri dev
